scripts.dev: dotenvx run -f config/env/.env -- bash scripts/dev/dev-server.sh start
scripts.dev:restart: dotenvx run -f config/env/.env -- bash scripts/dev/dev-server.sh restart
scripts.build: NODE_ENV=production dotenvx run -f config/env/.env -- vite build
scripts.build:patch: pnpm run version:patch && pnpm run build
scripts.serve:prod: NODE_ENV=production dotenvx run -f config/env/.env -- node build
scripts.check: pnpm run check:types && pnpm run check:svelte && pnpm run check:lint && pnpm run check:circular
scripts.check:lint: pnpm exec eslint --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern src packages repos serverless scripts ops *.config.js *.config.ts
scripts.check:circular: pnpm exec madge --circular --extensions ts,js,svelte src packages serverless ops --exclude "(^|/)dist/"
scripts.ci:gate: pnpm run check && pnpm run e2e:critical
scripts.e2e: pnpm run e2e:links && pnpm run e2e:sitemap && pnpm run e2e:auth && pnpm run e2e:admin && pnpm run e2e:admin:sync && pnpm run e2e:calendar && pnpm run e2e:contact && pnpm run e2e:visual && pnpm run e2e:layout:cls && pnpm run e2e:layout:drift
scripts.e2e:admin: pnpm exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 __tests__/e2e/admin-login-smoke.test.ts
scripts.e2e:admin:sync: pnpm exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 __tests__/e2e/admin-sync-queue-smoke.test.ts
scripts.e2e:calendar: pnpm exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 __tests__/e2e/calendar-events-flow.test.ts
scripts.e2e:critical: pnpm run e2e:links && pnpm run e2e:auth && pnpm run e2e:admin && pnpm run e2e:admin:sync && pnpm run e2e:calendar && pnpm run e2e:contact && pnpm run e2e:layout:cls
scripts.e2e:auth: pnpm exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 __tests__/e2e/auth-register-smoke.test.ts
scripts.e2e:contact: pnpm exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 __tests__/e2e/contact-submit-smoke.test.ts
scripts.e2e:layout:cls: pnpm exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 __tests__/e2e/layout-shift.test.ts
scripts.e2e:layout:drift: pnpm exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 __tests__/e2e/layout-drift.test.ts
scripts.e2e:links: pnpm exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 __tests__/e2e/dead-links.test.ts
scripts.e2e:sitemap: pnpm exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 __tests__/e2e/sitemap-smoke.test.ts
scripts.e2e:visual: pnpm exec svelte-kit sync && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 __tests__/e2e/visual-snapshots.test.ts
